description: This file contains utility methods related to AMQP link and session management using the Vert.x Proton library. It provides handlers for remote detach/close events, link lifecycle management, and context execution helpers.

classes.name: HonoProtonHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for managing AMQP links and sessions with Vert.x Proton.

methods.name: setDetachHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler invoked when a detach frame with 'close' property false is received from the peer, freeing resources afterward.

methods.name: setCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler invoked when a detach frame with 'close' property true is received, freeing resources afterward.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a default handler on a link for peer-initiated closing, responding with a detach if open, then freeing.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a default handler on a session to handle remote 'end' frames, closing and freeing session resources.

methods.name: isLinkEstablished
methods.description: Checks if a Proton link is established based on remote source/target.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes code on a specified Vert.x context, handling immediate or queued execution.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes an AMQP link with a default timeout and frees resources afterwards.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes an AMQP link with a specified timeout, waiting for peer detach or timeout before freeing resources.
